source_metadata.source_name: Government of India Daily Mandi Prices (data.gov.in / AGMARKNET)
source_metadata.resource_title: Current Daily Price of Various Commodities from Various Markets (Mandi)
source_metadata.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Directorate of Marketing & Inspection (DMI) / AGMARKNET
source_metadata.unit_verification: Standard Agmarknet mandi wholesale price unit confirmed via official portal documentation and Agmarknet metadata; not inferred from price values.
source_metadata.documentation_vs_headers: Portal documentation declares published units in Rs./Quintal and response format in JSON/XML/CSV. Observed response headers (Content-Type, Content-Length, Date) provide transport metadata but do not declare data units.

provenance_modes.policy: Mode LIVE_FETCH requires verified production HTTP transport and live credentials. Mode FILE_IMPORT applies to owner-selected real CSV/Excel APMC data imports (never sets is_live_verified=True or advances live-success index). Mode TEST_FIXTURE applies to offline test harnesses and mock transports, which must never set is_live_verified=True or advance the live-success index. Mode HISTORICAL_REPLAY preserves original observation dates and retrieval times.

kanpur_subdivision_policy.explanation: Administrative division separates Kanpur Nagar (urban/grain markets) from Kanpur Dehat (rural markets such as Jhijhank, Rura, Pukharayan). The five-district scope authorizes 'Kanpur' (Kanpur Nagar / Kanpur Grain APMC, Baripaal APMC, Uttaripura APMC, Choubepur APMC). 'Kanpur Dehat' records must not be silently merged into 'Kanpur' and are rejected/quarantined as out-of-scope subdivision records. This represents a repository operational scope boundary, not an official gazette determination.

data_validation_rules.missing_grade_policy: Missing, null, or whitespace-only grade values must be explicitly recorded as 'SOURCE_NOT_PROVIDED'. Silent mapping to 'FAQ' is strictly forbidden.
data_validation_rules.unknown_market_alias_policy: Markets not matching accepted canonical aliases in the reference alias table enter disposition 'REVIEW'.
data_validation_rules.price_bounds_rule: All price fields (min_price, modal_price, max_price) must be present, positive, and finite floats satisfying 0.0 < min_price <= modal_price <= max_price. Modal substitution for missing min/max is strictly forbidden. Non-positive, infinite, NaN, or inverted bounds are quarantined as INVALID_PRICE_BOUNDS.
data_validation_rules.conflict_safety_rule: When two or more observations in a batch share the identical natural key but divergent prices, ALL members of the conflict group are quarantined as CONFLICTING_QUOTE and removed from accepted outputs.
data_validation_rules.date_format_rule: Accept YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY. Reject future dates relative to reference date (IST). Unparseable dates quarantined as MALFORMED_DATE.
